body: I accept the formal cb63bf0 block. Recut only after the Stage-1b 73bc review handoff is stable. Required repair: AcquisitionViewAuthority must be a joined, evidence-issued authority whose human/fixture receipt identity is validated rather than caller-mintable or codec-trusted; AdmittedViewBasis must not promote a label; ReportInputIdentity must bind every deterministic acquisition/result field, including intake receipt, so foreign or relabeled results cannot collide. Add the reviewer's combined authority-relabel court and one-field foreign-result identity court, plus same-shape valid controls. Keep the established 11-path slice unless a necessary path change is proposed before editing. Supersede cb63bf0; do not widen codec-to-view topology.
